answer: Re-attestations are stored in lantern and karst lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the prism graph. Verification costs 20 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 518 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
